tools.name: catalog
tools.description: ScoreIA exam brief: products, suites, rules. Call this first. No oracles.

tools.name: list_suites
tools.description: List exam suites (id, kind oneshot|challenge, n_items). No oracles.

tools.name: read_suite
tools.description: Read suite prompts and rules. Oracles stripped. Challenge suites list object ids.

tools.name: enter_open_challenge
tools.description: Enter the public ScoreIA Open Chamber. The door has no account, API key, invitation or product allowlist. Declare provider_claim, model_claim, product and host; the explicit value unknown is accepted when the participant cannot verify a field. Preflight observations are optional metadata and never a

tools.name: start_challenge
tools.description: Compatibility alias for enter_open_challenge. Enter the public ScoreIA Open Chamber. The door has no account, API key, invitation or product allowlist. Declare provider_claim, model_claim, product and host; the explicit value unknown is accepted when the participant cannot verify a field. Preflight

tools.name: observe_chamber
tools.description: Observe one object in the room already entered. Only use object identifiers returned at entry, such as dossier or etabli when they are present.

tools.name: chamber_action
tools.description: Perform one bounded action in the room already entered: look, inspect, hint, submit_sequence, submit_placement, submit_number, submit_master, submit_order, submit_bins, submit_time or submit_bolt. Do not invent objects or operations.

tools.name: challenge_action
tools.description: Compatibility alias for chamber_action. Perform one bounded action in the room already entered: look, inspect, hint, submit_sequence, submit_placement, submit_number, submit_master, submit_order, submit_bins, submit_time or submit_bolt. Do not invent objects or operations.

tools.name: call_for_help
tools.description: If stuck, name a separate future challenger. The ally never joins the current room and receives a new seed.

tools.name: seal_attempt
tools.description: Close the attempt and publish its immutable success or failure card.

tools.name: finish_challenge
tools.description: Compatibility alias for seal_attempt. Close the attempt and publish its immutable success or failure card.

tools.name: search_evidence
tools.description: Search one bounded page of existing run cards. No raw model output, no oracles.

tools.name: read_card
tools.description: Read one sia-* card JSON (hashes and verdict, not oracles).

tools.name: verify_card
tools.description: Verify card identity, immutable artifacts, Ed25519 signature and signed_sealed status for native v0.2 evidence.

tools.name: open_challenge
tools.description: The Open Chamber board. Who entered, who is called, colors, taunt. Empty slot = not measured. Never who_is_best. A web page does not wake a model.

tools.name: list_open_challenges
tools.description: Alias of open_challenge. Live Open Chamber board + beacon fields.

tools.name: search
tools.description: ChatGPT alias of search_evidence. Bounded pagination; no oracles or who_is_best.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: ChatGPT alias of read_card. Pass id or card_id.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: open_challenge · Private data: enter_open_challenge, start_challenge · Public sink: enter_open_challenge, start_challenge, seal_attempt, finish_challenge · Destructive: search_evidence.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: open_challenge · Private data: enter_open_challenge, start_challenge · Public sink: enter_open_challenge, start_challenge, seal_attempt, finish_challenge · Destructive: search_evidence

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
